policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 14. Record eight confirmed mathematics, astronomy, physics, evolutionary biology, and anatomy science targets as verify-only science_retained checkpoints. No Person domain write is requested; all eight must remain live Production knowledge until final cutover.

review_scope.selection_rule: Choose a low-ambiguity science cohort whose live Production value is knowledge and whose latest numbered-batch assignment provenance is established. Exclude philosophy-science, science-technology, religion-science, and any unresolved Human Authoring provenance cases.

science_retained.basis: Newton's representative identity is mathematics and natural philosophy/physics, especially calculus, optics, mechanics, and universal gravitation. Under v2 these are science.
Galileo's representative identity is observational astronomy, mechanics, mathematical physics, and experimental investigation. Under v2 his representative domain is science.
Copernicus's representative identity is mathematical astronomy and the heliocentric model that transformed subsequent astronomy. Under v2 astronomy is science.
Gauss's representative identity is mathematics with major work across number theory, analysis, geometry, geodesy, astronomy, magnetism, and optics. Under v2 the representative domain is science.

von Neumann's representative identity is mathematics and mathematical science, spanning pure and applied mathematics, quantum mechanics, game theory, computing, and mathematical physics. Under v2 the representative domain is science.

Darwin's representative identity is natural history and evolutionary biology, especially the theory of evolution by natural selection supported through extensive scientific observation. Under v2 this is science.

Wallace's representative identity is natural history, evolutionary biology, and biogeography, including independent formulation of evolution by natural selection and foundational biogeographic work. Under v2 this is science.

Vesalius's representative identity is empirical human anatomy and medicine, especially De humani corporis fabrica and anatomy based on direct observation and dissection. Under v2 medicine and anatomy belong to science.
